The primary native DOMAIN_261 name supersedes using Instrument as a sender hint, but DOMAIN is not joined to a concrete CDC/LA_BCM/F_ZCU/R_ZCU ECU identifier in these records. The native enum also uses DOMAIN for0A0/0AE/0DC and other message families. Do not select a node by translatingDOMAIN to域控制器 alone.
